name: rasdaman
tagline: Array database for massive multidimensional rasters, with SQL-style queries and OGC WCPS services.
description: rasdaman (raster data manager) is one of the original array DBMSs. It stores huge multidimensional arrays such as satellite imagery, climate model output and sensor cubes as tiled, compressed objects and lets you slice, aggregate and combine them server-side with rasql, a SQL-style array language. It also serves OGC WCS, WMS, WMTS and WCPS, and its query model fed into the ISO SQL/MDA and OGC WCPS standards. It comes as an open-source community edition and a proprietary enterprise edition from rasdaman GmbH with federation and more. It is strongest for geospatial datacube services and remains a niche engine with a small community.

license.name: GPL-3.0 server / LGPL-3.0 clients (community); proprietary enterprise

pricing.notes: Community edition is free; rasdaman enterprise adds federation, extensibility and support.

scale.notes: Federation of multiple servers is an enterprise feature; single servers handle multi-TB datacubes.

strengths: Server-side slicing and aggregation of multi-TB raster datacubes
Standards-based OGC web services out of the box
Declarative array query language that shaped ISO SQL/MDA
weaknesses: Small community and limited documentation beyond geospatial use
Operationally heavier than file-based array formats like Zarr or TileDB
useCases: Climate and weather model output analysis
notIdealFor: Teams that prefer file formats in object storage
